apps.name: Lenny Explorer
apps.blurb: A personal archive reader for Lenny's Newsletter posts and podcast transcripts.

apps.name: Anthology '77
apps.blurb: An interactive archive of the Grateful Dead's legendary Spring 1977 tour. Map every show, read every setlist, hear the tapes.

apps.name: Systems Playground
apps.blurb: Interactive teaching tool for Donella H. Meadows' systems thinking - stocks, flows, feedback loops, delays, and the 12 leverage points.

apps.name: Strategy Wizard
apps.blurb: Build a real strategy - an action agenda, not a wish list. Guided, with an inline critic, based on Rumelt's Good Strategy / Bad Strategy.

apps.name: Bobby Bowser Arcade
apps.blurb: A 10-cabinet arcade of coding-craft minigames. Defeat bad practices, collect good ones.

apps.name: Octopus Antipatterns
apps.blurb: A personal study site for the 36 antipatterns in The Octopus Organization. Browse by category, drill with recall quizzes, and run a spot-it diagnostic on your own org.

apps.name: Golf Course Designer
apps.blurb: Shape nine holes of dirt, then watch a simulated field of real handicaps expose what you built. Every number on screen is a replayed round, not a rating.

apps.name: Golf Record
apps.blurb: Every round from my GHIN history - scoring trends, hole-by-hole splits, and where the strokes actually go.
